rows.capability: All 26 explicitly registered launch flags; help/version/info and completion
rows.difference: F05 implements local inspection, policy and presentation; C01 implements kubeconfig/context/namespace/timeout flags; B03 adds initial pod/context/namespace commands. Connection overrides, refresh and shell completion remain planned.

rows.capability: Context/kubeconfig/cluster/user/namespace selection and connection overrides
rows.difference: C01 implements read-only kubeconfig merging, explicit per-context SDK sessions, context/namespace selection and timeout states. Cluster/user/credential/TLS CLI overrides remain F05/C08. See docs/context-sessions.md for tested behavior and limits.

rows.capability: AWS EKS, Azure AKS, GKE and generic exec/OIDC/cert/token credentials
rows.difference: C01 qualifies static token/token-file, static embedded/file certificates and synthetic noninteractive exec-token contracts. EKS/AKS/GKE, interactive helpers, legacy providers and exec certificate rotation remain C06/C07/C08; no real-cloud compatibility claim.

rows.capability: TLS/CA/client certificates, proxy, request timeout and impersonation
rows.difference: C01 tests native kubeconfig TLS/CA/client certificates and request deadlines. Native proxies are explicit; proxy/provider qualification and CLI overrides/impersonation remain F05/C08/O04.

rows.capability: Context rename/delete and persisted per-context view/namespace preferences
rows.difference: C01 ordinary context/scope switching never rewrites kubeconfig. Persisted per-context view preferences and explicit rename/delete remain F03/M08.

rows.capability: API discovery, resource aliases and dynamic/CRD server columns
rows.difference: C02 implements discovery, backend aliases and consistent scoped snapshots. Dynamic/CRD columns and UI resource integration remain planned in the existing tasks; this does not establish full CORE01 parity.

rows.capability: Live resource updates, manual refresh, retry/reconnect and errors
rows.difference: B02 adds actual incremental pod rows and stale/error retention to the C03/C04 backend, including quiet renewal correction #107. Manual refresh and wider resource integration remain planned; no full CORE02 parity claim.

rows.capability: Resource command mode, aliases, autocomplete, namespace/context arguments
rows.difference: B03 implements available pod aliases, shared initial/interactive scope commands and local bounded Tab/arrow suggestions (#115). Preview #125 adds a real namespace workspace table and resource-aware command/history routing. Other resource tables, CRD/custom aliases and broader command routing remain their owning tickets. Focused #127 adds inline command suggestions without an overlay and stable shared frame/header geometry with mouse/resize checks. Focused #129 adds a bordered command bar and local context workspace table with retained filtering/history; captured container rows expose name-matched status/specification columns without claiming live usage.

rows.capability: Regex/inverse/fuzzy filtering, label/field selectors and filter history
rows.difference: B03 implements local case-insensitive literal text and Unicode VERSION1 regex filters with a total timeout, explicit errors and current snapshot/query guards. Inverse/fuzzy matching, selectors and saved filter history remain B07.

rows.capability: Breadcrumbs, back/forward/last-command navigation, namespace favorites
rows.difference: B03 implements bounded scope/filter/viewport history. Preview #125 retains pod/namespace resource kind and displays nested namespace/pod/container/log routes with the current Escape destination. Broader resource drill-down remains planned. Focused #129 adds a bordered command bar and local context workspace table with retained filtering/history; captured container rows expose name-matched status/specification columns without claiming live usage.

rows.capability: Keyboard/mouse, horizontal/vertical scrolling, paging, resize and Unicode
rows.difference: B02 qualifies live row navigation, paging, horizontal scrolling, Unicode, responsive 40×12 layouts and UID/scroll retention under updates. SSH/tmux and broader terminal qualification remain B07/Q02. Focused #127 adds inline command suggestions without an overlay and stable shared frame/header geometry with mouse/resize checks. Focused #129 adds a bordered command bar and local context workspace table with retained filtering/history; captured container rows expose name-matched status/specification columns without claiming live usage.

rows.capability: Typed sorting, movable/custom/wide columns, errors-only and selection ranges
rows.difference: B02 implements numeric restart/readiness and chronological age sorting, stable ties, reverse/header sorting and retained UID selection. Custom/wide/movable columns, error filters and selection ranges remain B07/U02.

rows.capability: Help, key hints, header/logo/breadcrumb visibility, fullscreen and quit behavior
rows.difference: Implemented pod, namespace, container and log shortcuts appear in the shared responsive header (#125); help retains secondary keys in short terminals. Per-view custom hotkeys and other resource actions remain planned. Focused #127 adds inline command suggestions without an overlay and stable shared frame/header geometry with mouse/resize checks.

rows.capability: YAML/describe/details, managedFields toggle, text search and auto-refresh
rows.difference: B04 delivers captured-UID pod YAML/details/events, managedFields visibility and literal text search. Automatic viewer refresh remains U06.

rows.capability: Copy resource/namespace/text with native clipboard and OSC52 over SSH/tmux
rows.difference: B04 and S02 copy redacted inspection/log text using Textual OSC52. Native clipboard and SSH/tmux qualification remain B07/Q02.

rows.capability: Save resources/logs, screen-dump browser and export path settings
rows.difference: S02 saves retained redacted timestamped logs to an explicit new private file without overwrite. Resource export, saved-export browsing and export path settings remain O06/F05.

rows.capability: About/branding and optional update notification
rows.difference: Preview #125 displays the actual installed application version in the shared header. A real optional cached/offline-safe release check remains U01 #56; no newer-release state is fabricated.

rows.capability: Pods/containers including init and ephemeral containers, events and namespaces
rows.difference: Live UID-based pod tables and captured regular/init container navigation are implemented. Preview #125 adds the real Namespace LIST/WATCH table with lifecycle/age, filtering, all-scope action and Enter/Escape restoration. Live container status, ephemeral containers and the remaining resource tables remain planned. Focused #129 adds a bordered command bar and local context workspace table with retained filtering/history; captured container rows expose name-matched status/specification columns without claiming live usage.

rows.capability: Deployments, StatefulSets, DaemonSets, ReplicaSets, replication controllers, workloads
rows.difference: Discover served API groups/versions rather than copying stale upstream GVR constants.

rows.capability: Services, Endpoints, EndpointSlices, Ingresses and NetworkPolicies
Nodes, PV/PVC, StorageClasses, priority/scheduling, HPA/PDB/quota/limits
ConfigMaps, Secrets, service accounts and RBAC resource families
Custom resources, unknown APIs and custom columns/jump chains
Current/previous logs, container selection and all-container/workload logs
rows.difference: S01/S02 implement captured-UID current/previous regular/init logs and a container selector. Aggregated all-container/workload output remains S06.

rows.capability: Head/tail/time windows, timestamps, wrap, follow/pause and column lock
rows.difference: S02 implements head 1000, tail 100/1000/all, relative or RFC3339 time windows, timestamps, wrapping, separate reception pause/viewport follow and column lock. Retained output is bounded; the API may rotate older output.

rows.capability: Log search/filter, clear, marks, fullscreen, copy/save and bounded buffering
rows.difference: S02 implements literal search/match navigation, clear/retained marks/fullscreen, bounded virtualized scrolling, redacted OSC52 copy and exclusive private-file save. Native clipboard, richer search/filter modes and saved-export browsing remain B07/O06.

rows.capability: Shell exec with chosen container and configurable shell command
rows.difference: S03/S04 provide captured, chosen-container native kubectl exec with a literal configured shell, private prepared-session connection, guarded launch and retained view on return. #119 adds a clean full-terminal entry and bounded captured-target heading. Actual Linux PTY, installed CLI and disposable-kind evidence is available. Remote SSH/tmux/macOS qualification remains Q02/full platform CI; this does not establish the full capability family. #121 replaces the default native shell route with an embedded Textual PTY/emulator and a persistent target frame; terminal compatibility/platform qualification still remains open.

rows.capability: Attach to running containers and bidirectional file transfer
Pod/container/service port forwarding, listing, deletion and bind address
FastForward annotations, named ports, multiple presets and WebSocket transport
rows.difference: Cluster annotations require local opt-in before automatic listeners start.

rows.capability: Read-only mode, permissions, target validation and dangerous-action gates
rows.difference: F04 implements immutable client/UID targets and safe text/argv helpers. F05 stage 1 applies a shared immutable read-only command policy to CLI/UI; actual exec/attach/plugin/mutation service integration and RBAC evidence remain planned. Application read-only is not a security boundary.

rows.capability: Edit manifests with external editor and conflict/diff validation
rows.difference: S03 implements captured editor argv/file boundaries and the shared process/terminal lifecycle. Manifest editing, preview/conflict handling and cluster writes remain M02.

rows.capability: Scale, restart and rollback workloads; deployment ReplicaSet drill-down
Delete/force-delete/bulk actions and pod completed/error cleanup
rows.difference: Force-delete keeps an explicit confirmation; instant unconfirmed deletion is an intentional safety difference.

Local manifest directories, YAML edit, apply/delete and Kustomize
Helm list/status/notes/values/all-values/manifest/history

Global/per-context themes, transparent colors, light/dark inversion, icon settings

rows.capability: Aliases, hotkeys, columns, alignment/width/order, context/resource view overrides

Plugin environment/column/resource expansion and foreground/background execution

Every bundled community plugin workflow and external-tool dependency
rows.difference: Inventory includes all plugin files. External Argo/Flux/Helm/AI tools keep their own support/licensing; optional services are never required by Kubetrol.

RBAC can/user/group/service-account policies and rule inspection

Node shell helper pods, configurable image/namespace/limits/host mounts

Additional K9sAlpha capabilities beyond the public baseline
